name: ribbon
description: Shared USDC tabs settled in one transaction on Arc.

scripts.test: npm run export-abi && hardhat test && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run export-abi && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
